evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies connection management and reachable network handling in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
rationale: Dynamic reachability detection avoids futile outbound connection attempts and AddrMan slot exhaustion in environments lacking IPv6 routes. The PR description notes that IPv6 peers currently 'take up spots in AddrMan, and we make futile attempts to connect to them (e.g. feelers or network-specific connections)' when routing is absent.
